rows.grounds: comparative or superlative sense in context of ranking materials
ablative of comparison referring to previously mentioned material

items.question: Which material is declared superior to the previously mentioned gem?
premises: A previously mentioned material serves as the point of comparison.
Something is described as excellent in relation to that material.
Silver is identified as the most excellent material.
items.inference: Silver is superior to the previously mentioned material.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tasmāt depends on the preceding verse's final item.
items.plain_english: Better than that, however, silver is the most excellent.
